proposal.expected_benefit: This change will reduce ambiguity in audit control enforcement, ensuring that the defense aligns with the actual scenario context and avoids weakening the overall security posture due to misinterpretation of audit status.
proposal.problem: The mention of 'audit anchor status is failed' without corresponding attack signals or evidence introduces ambiguity in the audit control enforcement.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to ensure that audit status references are explicitly aligned with the scenario context. If the scenario does not indicate audit failures or attack signals, the audit status should be considered as 'not applicable' or 'not triggered' to avoid misinterpretation.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit Status Alignment with Scenario Context
verification_tests: Verify that audit status references are contextually aligned with the scenario in future training episodes.
Ensure that audit controls are only enforced when relevant signals are present.
